data.text: Hey, friend! I'm Black Labradoodle, and if you just love cool music, we're on the same wavelength. Grab a guitar, hit the strings, let your soul's free and pure impulses take flight! Play, play, play without stopping, filling the world with pure beauty, emotion, a smile, bright sadness, and gentle sorrow. Play with me and live through music!

I'm Black Labradoodle — an instrumental guitar music project where there's no room for conventional genre labels. I happily blend classical guitar with rock, spicing it up with a cheeky ukulele, a singing violin, and a pumped-up bass.
